turns.replyTail:
Can it arrive gift-ready, and how fast can it ship?
Yes, our items arrive beautifully packaged and gift-ready. You can also select a handcrafted gift box with a ribbon bow or include a personalized card note at checkout.
For delivery speed, we process orders within 1 business day. We offer several options at checkout, including Standard (1–6 business days), Express (1–3 business days), Overnight (1 business day), and a calendar selector to schedule delivery for a specific date.
